title: City Council District 8
statement: District 8 stands firmly with Eastlake rather than leaving it to slide under a decay momentum of 3 and sentiment of -0.06 against the city baseline of 0.045. We are maintaining rigorous oversight across our commercial corridors, voting to advance the $2.5M Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake ordinance on the floor while locking in documented administrative reviews and service parity for Eastlake.

payload.text: I vote to pass the $2.5M Commercial Stabilization for Grand Lake ordinance (INIT-009) with auditable disbursement milestones and formally submit the Eastlake commercial stabilization review for administrative implementation.

numberMoved: Eastlake sentiment at -0.06 vs city 0.045 with decay momentum 3
